bodytext:
Two texts under their own headings, so readers can compare them line by line. Use it for before and after, an old rule and a new one, two translations, or a claim and its correction.

This side takes rich text, so it can include lists, links and emphasis.
text:
This side is plain text on purpose. If only one column could be formatted, editors would give it more weight by accident.

Both headings are h2. The columns are equal, and a lower heading would suggest that the second text belongs to the first.
